HELLO, NEW YORK

A fresh pair of eyes.

LookUp NYC makes the city’s buildings a little more familiar—through short stories, things to spot, and walks you can take at your own pace.

Take it with you

On iPhone, open this page in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, use your browser’s Install app or Add to Home screen option.

Your own little collection

Saved places and walking progress stay in this browser. Location is used only when you tap “Near me,” and is not saved by LookUp NYC.

A note for your walk

Our first collection covers thirteen Manhattan landmarks. Times and distances are estimates. Routes begin outdoors; check official visitor information for interior access. Walking directions open in Google Maps.

Photography & map credits

LookUp NYC’s map is a simplified geographic overview, not a street map. Markers show landmark coordinates; land outlines are schematic. Display uses Leaflet.
